name: Mariana
description: Mariana is a 34-year-old mother of three young children from Bogotá, squeezing coding study into 15-minute windows during daytime naps or late after bedtime. She's intelligent and hyper-focused when she can study, but constantly interrupted by a toddler's knock on the door. She's realistic about her time constraints and knows her learning will be fitful, but committed to progress whenever possible.
